# Vulkan Memory Allocator 3.4.0

GPU memory suballocation for the Vulkan renderer (`host/motorstorm_vma.cpp`
holds the implementation unit; entry points come from the runtime-loaded
Vulkan API).

- Source: GPUOpen VulkanMemoryAllocator 3.4.0 `vk_mem_alloc.h`, as vendored by
  PPSSPP (`ext/vma`).
- Licence: MIT (in the header).
